rationale: The stock gapped down ~5.6% on a severe EPS miss (-120% surprise) with elevated relative volume (6x), but price is now sitting at 80.9% of today's range near the 9-EMA ($47.08), suggesting the initial selling has largely been absorbed and there is no clean directional setup. The last five 1-minute candles show tight, low-volume consolidation with no breakout or breakdown momentum, making both a long fade-recovery and a short continuation equally uncertain. With two working orders already consuming ~8% of buying power and a strong realized P&L cushion worth protecting, the risk/reward does not justify adding exposure here.
